name: Littmann Classic II Pediatric, Rainbow Finish (2153)
metaDescription: The Littmann Classic II Pediatric stethoscope with a rainbow finish chestpiece and Caribbean blue tube. A bright, fun gift for nurses who work with kids.
summary: A rainbow finish Classic II Pediatric stethoscope with a Caribbean blue tube, about as cheerful as a stethoscope gets for a peds nurse.
whyItWorks: Kids notice color, and so do the nurses who care for them. A rainbow finish chestpiece catches the light and gives a child something interesting to look at during an exam, while the Caribbean blue tube keeps the look bright and friendly. For a pediatric nurse who already decorates their badge reel and wears character scrubs, this stethoscope fits right in with the rest of their gear.

It is part of Littmann's Classic II Pediatric line, made for smaller patients, and the title also mentions a brass stem and headset that add to the colorful look. That makes it a memorable gift for a nurse starting at a children's hospital, finishing a pediatric residency program, or celebrating years on a peds unit. It is also a lovely thank you from a family whose child was cared for by a nurse who made a hard stay easier. Few nurses buy a rainbow stethoscope for themselves, which is part of what makes it feel special.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos to see how the rainbow finish looks, since it varies with lighting.
Pediatric models are sized for children, so this is best for nurses who mainly care for kids.
Consider a stethoscope ID tag, since a colorful model can still look like a coworker's in a peds unit.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a pediatric nurse?
faq.a: Yes. It is designed for pediatric patients and the colorful finish suits the playful feel of most peds units.

faq.q: How is this different from the plain Classic II Pediatric?
faq.a: It has a rainbow finish chestpiece and a brass stem and headset, while the standard 2119 version has a regular stainless steel chestpiece.
